evidence.title: Granola — The AI Notepad for back-to-back meetings
Granola For | AI Meeting Notes for Every Role | Granola

name: Granola
summary: Bot-free AI notepad for meetings that enhances your notes from the transcript and lets you query past meetings.
description: AI notepad for meetings on macOS, Windows, iOS and Android. You write notes during the call; Granola captures device audio (no bot joins the call), enhances your notes from the transcript, and generates summaries, action items and follow-up emails. Chat answers questions across all meetings with source citations, while recipes and 29+ templates cover sales calls, 1-on-1s, investor pitches and PRDs. Free tier; Business and Enterprise add unlimited history and integrations.
contains: bot-free capture via device audio; works with Zoom, Meet, Teams, Slack, WebEx
notes enhanced from transcript, AI additions shown in gray
chat across meetings with source citations
29+ meeting templates and recipes (follow-up emails, feature requests, PRDs)
integrations: Slack, Notion, HubSpot, Affinity, Attio, Zapier, MCP
apps for macOS, Windows, iOS, Android, Apple Watch
pricing: Basic $0, Business $14, Enterprise $35 per user/month
